examples.text: evam'eva kho, rājakumāra, yaṃ tathāgato vācaṃ jānāti abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ sā ca paresaṃ appiyā amanāpā, na taṃ tathāgato vācaṃ bhāsati.

attānañ'ca parañ'ca anupahacca kho pana, bhikkhave, dānaṃ datvā yattha yattha tassa dānassa vipāko nibbattati, aḍḍho ca hoti mahaddhano mahābhogo, na c'assa kutoci bhogānaṃ upaghāto āgacchati aggito vā udakato vā rājato vā corato vā appiyadāy'ādato vā. imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca sappurisadānānī'ti.

hoti so samayo, yaṃ dubbhikkhaṃ hoti dussassaṃ dullabhapiṇḍaṃ, tattha na sukaraṃ appadhanena yāpetuṃ, tathāvidhe āgate dubbhikkhe vā me bhavissati. yathārūpā āpadā uppajjanti aggito vā udakato vā appiyadāy'ādato vā, tathārūpāsu vā uppannāsu āpadāsu me bhavissatī'ti'pi puriso nidhiṃ nidhetī'ti.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe n'ādhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe na byāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso
so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe sārajjati, appiyarūpe rūpe byāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso.

examples.text: so vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ime pañca āvaraṇe nīvaraṇe cetaso ajjhāruhe paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe appahāya, abalāya paññāya dubbalāya att'atthaṃ vā ñassati
jiṇṇo'ham'asmi abalo vītavaṇṇo, nettā na suddhā savanaṃ na phāsu, m'āhaṃ nassaṃ momuho antarā'va, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.

7179.commentary: (MNa) avasā abalā avīriyā'ti tesaṃ attano vaso vā balaṃ vā vīriyaṃ vā n'atthi.

examples.text: n'atthi balaṃ, n'atthi vīriyaṃ, n'atthi purisathāmo, n'atthi purisaparakkamo, sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā avīriyā niyatisaṃgatibhāvapariṇatā chasv'ev'ābhijātīsu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī'ti.

abala + ka
7180.synonym: abala, dubbala, dubbalaka, dubbalī, sanna, hīnavīriya

examples.text: ath'āpare patāresi vacchatare vacchatariyo. te'pi tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu. ath'āpare patāresi vacchake kisa-abalake. te'pi tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu.
nivatth'avatthen'eva gehato nikkhamitvā paramasallekhavuttiko'pi abalabalo amandamando viya paresaṃ acittakarūpena hīḷitaparibhūto hutvā gāmanigamarājadhānīsu ekarattivāsen'eva vicarati.

7182.meaning1: very feeble; extremely weak; (comm) extremely dull-witted
7182.commentary: (VINa) abalabalo viyā'ti abalo kira bondo vuccati, atisay'atthe ca idaṃ āmeḍitaṃ, tasmā atibondo viyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: manussā taṃ bhikkhuṃ passitvā evam'āhaṃsu, kv'āyaṃ abalabalo viya mandamando viya bhākuṭikabhākuṭiko viya? ko imassa upagatassa piṇḍakam'pi dassati?

7185.meaning1: unconcerned (about); not caring (about); not giving heed (to); without respect (for)
7185.commentary: (SNa) abahukato'ti akatabahumāno. (SNt) bahukataṃ vuccati bahukāro bahumāno, n'atthi etassa bahukatan'ti abahukato, akatabahumāno.

examples.text: ahañ'hi, bhante, pubbe agārikabhūto samāno abahukato ahosiṃ dhammena abahukato saṅghena. so khv'āhaṃ bhagavati pemañ'ca gāravañ'ca hiriñ'ca ottappañ'ca sampassamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.

7186.meaning1: not practised often; not repeated a lot; not done again and again

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kāyagatāsati abhāvitā abahulīkatā, taṃ cakkhu āviñchati manāpiyesu rūpesu, amanāpiyā rūpā paṭikūlā honti
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno mettācetovimutti abhāvitā abahulīkatā so suppadhaṃsiyo hoti amanussehi.

7187.grammar: nt, abstr, comp, from na bahulīkata, neg
7187.meaning1: fact of not having practised often; fact of not having repeated a lot; fact of not having done again and again
7187.construction:

abahulīkata + tta

examples.text: satisambojjh'aṅgassa … upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgassa, imesaṃ kho, bhikkhu, sattannaṃ bojjh'aṅgānaṃ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā duppañño eḷamūgo'ti vuccatī'ti.

7191.meaning1: not foolish; not ignorant; not stupid; not immature

examples.text: kassa hi nāma, bhante, abālassa aduṭṭhassa amūḷhassa avipallatthacittassa āyasmā sāriputto na rucceyya?
tatra, bhikkhave, ye te makkaṭā abālajātikā alolajātikā, te taṃ lepaṃ disvā ārakā parivajjanti. yo pana so hoti makkaṭo bālajātiko lolajātiko, so taṃ lepaṃ upasaṅkamitvā hatthena gaṇhāti.

7193.meaning1: no public teaching; no external doctrine
7193.commentary: (SNa) anantaraṃ abāhiran'ti dhammavasena vā puggalavasena vā ubhayaṃ akatvā. ettakaṃ dhammaṃ parassa na desessāmī'ti hi cintento dhammaṃ abbhantaraṃ karoti nāma, ettakaṃ parassa desessāmī'ti cintento bāhiraṃ karoti nāma. imassa puggalassa desessāmī'ti cintento pana puggalaṃ abbhantaraṃ karoti nāma, imassa na desessāmī'ti cintento puggalaṃ bāhiraṃ karoti nāma. evaṃ akatvā desito'ti attho.

examples.text: desito, ānanda, mayā dhammo anantaraṃ abāhiraṃ karitvā. n'atth'ānanda, tathāgatassa dhammesu ācariyamuṭṭhi.

7194.meaning1: not very strong; not extreme; not intense
7194.commentary: (DNa) abāḷhaṃ giraṃ so na bhaṇi pharusan'ti ettha akāro parato bhaṇisaddena yojetabbo. bāḷhan'ti balavaṃ atipharusaṃ. (DNt) abāḷhan'ti vā ettha a-kāro vuddhi-attho asekkhā dhammā'ti-ādīsu (dha. sa. tikamātikā 11) viya, tasmā ativiya bāḷhaṃ pharusaṃ giran'ti evam'ettha attho veditabbo.
7194.notes: The commentary suggests the a- should be combined with bhaṇi.

examples.text: akkosabhaṇḍanavihesakāriṃ, ubbādhikaṃ bahujanappamaddanaṃ, abāḷhaṃ giraṃ so na bhaṇi pharusaṃ, madhuraṃ bhaṇi susaṃhitaṃ sakhilaṃ.
